package.name: bonbon_patient_kiosk_bringup
package.description: Bringup for the dedicated patient-facing kiosk screen: launches bonbon_patient_kiosk and nothing else. This package launches no node code of its own -- it is composition only, mirroring bonbon_ui_api_bringup's pattern for Pi-1's staff dashboard, but for a separate physical screen/host per the plan decision that the patient kiosk must not share hardware with the staff operator dashboard.
